input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: The separator selection negates any_prefix_is_slash, picking ' / ' exactly when an option spelling already starts with a slash and '; ' otherwise.
- failure path: An option declared as --shout/--no-shout renders in --help as '--shout; --no-shout', and a Windows-style /debug;/no-debug option renders as '/debug / /no-debug', where the slash separator is indistinguishable from the slash prefix of the names.

Reviewer finding
- description: The separator conditional was inverted when moved into get_help_spec. The original code used "; " if any_prefix_is_slash else " / "; the new code uses "; " if not any_prefix_is_slash else " / ".
- rationale: Trigger: an option with both primary and secondary opts, such as --shout/--no-shout. Normally any_prefix_is_slash is False, so the old code joined with " / " but the new code joins with "; ". Help output changes from "--shout / --no-shout" to "--shout; --no-shout". For slash-prefixed opts like /debug;/no-debug the separator is also flipped.
critique: The finding pinpoints the negated any_prefix_is_slash conditional in separator selection. It gives the same consequences as the label: --shout/--no-shout renders with '; ', and slash-prefixed options get the flipped separator.
